description: This PHP source file defines the SavePayGradeController class, which manages the rendering logic for adding or editing pay grades in the OrangeHRM system's admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and dynamically sets Vue components and properties based on request attributes.

classes.name: SavePayGradeController
classes.description: Controller for handling save operations for pay grades, setting the appropriate Vue component based on whether an ID is present in the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, choosing between 'pay-grade-edit' and 'pay-grade-add' based on the presence of an ID attribute in the request.
